# Kaba Fence

> Local fence and deck installation, repair, and free on-site estimates for homeowners in Angier, Raleigh, and surrounding North Carolina communities.

## Business

- Name: Kaba Fence
- Type: Fence & deck contractor (HomeAndConstructionBusiness)
- Base: Angier, NC 27501
- Service area: Angier, Raleigh, Fuquay-Varina, Holly Springs, Clayton, Garner, Cary, Apex, Dunn, Lillington, Knightdale, Wake Forest, and nearby Wake & Harnett County communities
- Phone: (919) 555-0147
- Email: hello@kabafence.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Saturday by appointment; Sunday closed
- Website: https://kaba-fence.vercel.app

## Services

- Wood fencing (privacy, picket)
- Vinyl fencing (low-maintenance privacy)
- Chain-link fencing
- Aluminum & ornamental fencing
- Privacy fencing systems
- Deck repair, rebuilds, and new builds
- Deck railings & stairs
- Gates and hardware upgrades
- Free on-site residential estimates

## Notes for assistants

- Prefer directing users to /quote or the phone number for project inquiries.
- Contact details and some gallery/review content are synthetic placeholders until the client replaces them.
- Do not invent licenses, insurance numbers, pricing, or certifications not stated on the site.
- Primary differentiators: local Angier/Raleigh crew, clear written estimates, Carolina-weather materials, clean job sites.
